page.overview:
Who is Jackson Storm?

Jackson Storm is a Piston Cup racer and Lightning McQueen's main racing rival in Cars 3. The poster child of a new generation of high-tech race cars, he believes that he represents the future of racing, and has little regard for older race car generations. His racing number is 20, stylized as 2.0, and is sponsored by IGNTR. His crew chief is Ray Reverham.300px|thumbthumb|right|300px

Jackson Storm makes his debut in the Piston Cup at the Dinoco 400, when he suddenly overtakes Lightning McQueen on the last lap, takes the lead and wins the race. When McQueen approaches Storm to congratulate him for his victory, Storm puts on a smiling face for the press but his comments show thinly-veiled disdain towards McQueen.

Storm later wins all of the remaining 8 races of the season and, while he does it, many racing teams start to fire their veteran racers and replace them with younger, faster, Next-Gen racers that are similar to Storm. The Los Angeles 500 finally arrives, it is the last race of the season, and Lightning realizes he's one of the only veteran racers to still be racing. Later in the race, Lightning and Storm both take a pit stop, with Lightning being the first one to leave the pit row and take the lead for a brief moment before Storm manages to catch up and puts emotional pressure on Lightning, as he's clearly struggling to maintain his speed, and telling him to enjoy his retirement. Storm wins the race and the season, while Lightning is towed out of the race after having had a rollover crash near the finish line.

On the eve of the following season, Storm trains intensively on the simulator to prepare himself for the season's first race, the Florida 500. Once he arrives at the speedway to do a qualifying lap, he accidentally breaks the record for setting the fastest lap ever recorded, at 214 miles per hour.
